info.title: Mock Data Generator
info.description: Generates realistic mock data for Microsoft business applications including Dataverse, Business Central, Field Service, Project Operations, and Supply Chain Management.

get.description: Generates mock account objects with realistic business data including contact information, addresses, and financial details. These accounts form the foundation for relationship chains - use the same seedValue when calling GetDataverseContacts to create realistic company structures.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of account records to generate (between 1 and 100).

parameters.name: seedValue
parameters.description: Use the same number (e.g., 12345) across multiple API calls to generate related records that reference each other. Different numbers create different relationship patterns. Recommended ranges: 1-9999 (small datasets), 10000-99999 (medium), 100000-999999 (large).

200.description: Successfully generated mock account data.

count.description: Total number of accounts returned.

get.description: Generates mock contact objects with realistic personal and professional information including names, contact details, and job information. Contacts are automatically linked to a shared pool of Account IDs for consistent relationships. 💡 Workflow Tip: Call GetDataverseAccounts first, then use the same seedValue here for realistic company structures.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of contact records to generate (between 1 and 100).

parameters.name: seedValue
parameters.description: Use the same number (e.g., 12345) across multiple API calls to generate related records that reference each other. Different numbers create different relationship patterns. Recommended ranges: 1-9999 (small datasets), 10000-99999 (medium), 100000-999999 (large).

count.description: Total number of contacts returned.
